# Shamsudin Aalam - Full Profile

> Shamsudin Aalam (also spelled Samsudin Alam) is a Software Developer specializing in Laravel & PHP with 3+ years of experience building production-grade APIs, enterprise web applications, and third-party integrations (Amadeus, DHL, FedEx, payment gateways). Based in Kathmandu, Nepal.

## Summary

Software Developer specializing in Laravel & PHP with 3+ years of experience building production-grade APIs, enterprise web applications, and third-party integrations (Amadeus, DHL, FedEx, payment gateways). Currently developing a banking audit system, with hands-on experience in Docker containerization and GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment. Specialized in MySQL and PostgreSQL optimization, RESTful API development, and server deployment on DigitalOcean/Ubuntu. Frontend collaboration experience with Vue.js and Bootstrap. Currently learning Python and Django to broaden backend skills.

  - Developed and maintained 10+ Laravel web applications serving thousands of users with optimized backend performance and scalable architecture.

  - Performed database optimization using indexing, caching, and eager loading.

  - Contributed to backend development of a travel platform using Laravel and MySQL.
  - Worked under senior developers to implement API integrations and booking workflows.
